rows.name: BRP Inc.
rows.impact: Expects Q3 fiscal 2027 normalized diluted EPS to be down about 50% to 60% year over year, "mainly due to the increased tariff impact." On the results call, the CFO put net Section 232 and 338 tariff exposure at C$200 million for fiscal 2027 (about C$225 million annualized).
rows.src2_name: results call, via The Canadian Press

rows.name: Supremex Inc.
rows.impact: Estimated net tariff impact on pre-tax operating earnings of C$10.0 million to C$12.0 million a year, after mitigation. Announced a restructuring cutting about 60 jobs.

rows.name: Algoma Steel Group Inc.
rows.impact: Direct tariff costs of C$18.1 million in Q3 2026 (C$89.7 million in Q3 2025). Says 50% U.S. Section 232 tariffs "continue to severely restrict" its access to the U.S. market.
rows.div: None. Suspended in 2025; no dividend declared in Q3 2026

rows.name: Canfor Corporation
rows.impact: Net duties and tariff expense of C$34.2 million in Q2 2026, including C$10.1 million of Section 232 tariffs (C$62.3 million and C$18.2 million year to date).

rows.name: Interfor Corporation
rows.impact: Export duties and tariffs expense of C$44.6 million in Q2 2026, including C$10.3 million of Section 232 tariffs (C$81.3 million and C$18.7 million year to date).

rows.name: Western Forest Products Inc.
rows.impact: Export tax expense of C$15.6 million in Q2 2026 (C$8.8 million a year earlier), up "due to higher duty rates and tariffs."
rows.div: None. Suspended Nov 2023, before these tariffs

rows.name: Cascades Inc.
rows.impact: Expects to limit the annualized impact of the 50% Section 338 tariffs to "not more than 5% of its adjusted EBITDA run rate." Its Q3 2026 outlook excludes tariff impacts.

rows.name: Hammond Manufacturing Company Limited
rows.impact: Had Section 338 tariffs applied for the year to June 26, 2026, estimates they would have hit about 3.5% of net sales and cut net income by about 60 basis points.

rows.name: High Liner Foods Incorporated
rows.impact: About US$5.7 million of IEEPA tariffs in Q2 2026 cost of sales (US$2.8 million a year earlier), before a US$7.9 million IEEPA tariff recovery booked in the quarter.

rows.name: West Fraser Timber Co. Ltd.
rows.impact: No dollar cost given. Says about 15% of its 2026 MDF shipments fall under the widened Section 338 tariff scope from Oct 30, 2026. Its U.S. lumber and OSB shipments aren't affected by Section 338.
